# vendor/

Third-party TallyPrime integrations vendored per SPEC.md "Reuse existing Tally
integrations first". Read-only reference material; not imported at runtime.

| Path | Source | Version / commit | License |
|------|--------|------------------|---------|
| `tally_mcp_pypi/` | PyPI `tally-mcp` (`pip download tally-mcp --no-deps`) | 0.2.0 | MIT (`License-Expression: MIT` in wheel METADATA) |
| `taxor-tally-mcp/` | https://github.com/taxor-ai/tally-mcp | `d1fb008` 2026-04-23 | MIT (README "License: MIT License"; upstream ships no LICENSE file — see `taxor-tally-mcp/LICENSE.NOTE`) |

What we took from each is recorded in `docs/DECISIONS.md`.
